Index.description: Merge Multiple Markdown Files into One for Free
Index.faq1A: Merge Markdown supports .md, .markdown, and plain-text .txt files. Any file you can write Markdown in will work.
Index.faq2Q: How many files can I merge at once?
Index.faq2A: There is no hard limit on the number of files. You can add as many as you need. Note that the live preview is capped at 5 MB for performance — the downloaded file always contains the full merged content.
Index.faq3Q: What order will the files be merged in?
Index.faq3A: Files are merged in the order they appear in the list. You can drag and drop the cards to reorder them before downloading.
Index.faq4Q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
Index.faq4A: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device, so your content stays private.
Index.faq5Q: What separates each file in the merged output?
Index.faq5A: Each file is separated by a Markdown horizontal rule (---) followed by a blank line, keeping the merged document clean and well-structured.
Index.faq6Q: Can I preview the result before downloading?
Index.faq6A: Yes. The right panel shows a live preview that updates as you add, remove, or reorder files. You can switch between a rendered view and the raw Markdown source.
